title: Get DLP Job Trigger
description: Gets a job trigger by its full resource name.

objective.narrative: The `get_job_trigger` method retrieves the details of a specific job trigger identified by its ID. This is useful for checking the status, configuration, and history of a scheduled DLP scan.
